nodes.label: Gradus ad Parnassum
nodes.text: A retrieval system over musical notation that parses and annotates scores, then answers theory questions with measure references.

nodes.label: Kit AI
nodes.text: An offline-first emergency first-aid PWA with IndexedDB retrieval and an online/offline text-to-speech fallback. A related fine-tuned Llama 3.2 3B model remains a separate experiment.

nodes.label: Accordo
nodes.text: A booking and payments marketplace for musicians, covering bookings, contracts, and payment workflows.

nodes.label: Nova
nodes.text: A Solana Pay invoicing app with QR payments, transaction tracking, and dashboards. It won Best Use of Solana at SwampHacks.
